text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ora ora ora oraaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I won't let you have it!! Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaaaaaagh!! Like hell I'm gonna 
loseeee!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how steep the mountain, I shall 
overcome it!! Reach the brilliance of the 
aurora! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Go! Go! Go! Do your best, everyoneeeee—!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "No, please! Ogriiiiiiin!!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This is where Oguri Cap makes her 
comeback! Right, Oguri!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right. As long as I have 
everyone's voices— I can run!! Hyaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—No, no, NO, NO!! The one who wins... the 
strongest is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: DON'T RUN IN FRONT OF MEEEEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki! It's Yaeno Muteki!! She's 
surging forward with incredible momentum!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki takes first place!! Crushing 
her formidable rivals, she has claimed the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
(Waaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ――Gh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san... Jeez! If you do that, I 
won't be able to hold back anymore...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to run...! As one of the "Big 
Three." I want to race against you as you 
are right now, too!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*, *wheeze*, *huff*...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Geez, to think you had this much in you! 
You've been hiding your talents way too 
much, buddy!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inari-san...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's what you look like running 
up front, huh?! Haha, so that's your true 
face!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I like it! Way better than acting all cool 
and aloof!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got all fired up too!! Yaeno, that was 
intensely hot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad we can go all out against 
each other! Bring on everything you've 
got, Yaeno!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. Today, I felt like I truly 
resonated with Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The roar of your soul echoes within me... 
Ah, I want to run with you again—as soon 
as possible.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone... th... Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-chan... you worked so very hard, 
didn't you? There must have been painful 
and frightening times, too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for overcoming that and taking 
on the challenge... Thanks to you, it was 
a wonderful race!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're... incredible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Power just kept overflowing from inside 
you without stopping. It took me by 
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Being able to generate that much power on 
your own is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Running with you is fun. Let's run 
together again."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to keep running with everyone, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Running with my emotions ablaze, who knew 
it could feel this... refreshing?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki, congratulations!! You 
finally did it! I'm completely overcome 
with emotion!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right! Yaeno Muteki is... the 
girl who raced against Ogurin so many 
times...! I had no idea she was that cool!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
The prowess to stand toe-to-toe with the 
Eternal Big Three time and again... You're 
truly incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I've always believed that Yaeno Muteki, 
Mejiro Ardan, and Sakura Chiyono O were 
the 'Big Three'!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the Big Six when you add them all 
together?! What an incredible generation!!

Applause erupted from all across the 
stands, and the name Yaeno Muteki was 
shouted aloud.

Looking up at the stands with deep 
emotion— Yaeno Muteki then bowed deeply.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Allow me to introduce myself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My name is Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I sincerely hope you will continue to 
watch over my running from here on out!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much!!
(Ooooooohhhh!)

To her resolute, warrior-like words, the 
crowd of 170,000 responded with thunderous 
applause—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-dono.
choice_data_list: Congratulations! I'm so glad for you!

text_block_list.text:
I shouted out in excitement without 
thinking. Recalling the sight of Yaeno 
Muteki surrounded by smiling rivals filled 
my chest with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone who believed in me... 
I've gained just a little bit of 
confidence in myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That there was something about me worthy 
of praise too.
choice_data_list:
There are plenty of things about you I'd 
love to praise.

There are so many things I could praise 
you for.

text_block_list.text:
Her earnestness, her sense of duty, her 
politeness, her dedication, her 
thoughtfulness, her kindness... I rattled 
off every good trait that came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaat!? I-Isn't that a bit of an 
exaggeration...!?
choice_data_list:
I'm not exaggerating. There's still so 
much more!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: N-N-Nooo!! Right around there!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I-I am honored, but... my heart cannot 
take it...

Perhaps unused to receiving praise, Yaeno 
Muteki blushed bright red and looked down 
in embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... Today was filled with so many 
wonderful things... I feel a little 
light-headed.
choice_data_list: Go ahead, soak it in as much as you want.

text_block_list.text:
"Today's victory carries that much value. 
Not just the result, but the process that 
led to it as well."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, in that case... Tonight, I would 
like to drift off to sleep, immersed in 
this bliss.
With that, Yaeno Muteki smiled blissfully.

It may only be a fleeting moment of rest— 
but may it gently heal her, who has kept 
running despite all the hurt.
